title: 8 Best Softr Alternatives in 2026: Honest Comparison
summary: Tired of Softr's Airtable dependency and user limits? These 8 Softr alternatives let you build portals, tools, and apps without the spreadsheet lock-in.
body_markdown: For simple client portals built on Airtable data, Softr is faster to get started with — the templates are pre-built and the sync is seamless. Bubble's learning curve is real: most users take a week before the platform feels natural. But for anything with custom business logic, complex permissions, or consumer-facing features, Bubble is significantly more capable. If you want AI generation to shortcut the complexity gap,[Blink](https://blink.new/) generates full-stack apps from a description in minutes, without the Bubble learning curve.
